title: Sign up and verify the e-mail
caption: Step through the sign-up as an OTA owner; check each expected result.

steps.title: Open the sign-up page
steps.body: Fill in full name, e-mail and a password of at least 12 characters.
steps.expect: The form shows inline errors for a short password.

steps.title: Open the e-mail
steps.body: Open Mailpit and click the verification link.
steps.expect: The browser lands on `/verify-email` and shows success.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.body: Sign in with the new account.
steps.expect: The dashboard opens; `last_login_at` is set. See [[session-cookie]].
